BUILT TO YOUR LIST.

1 · Full-bleed hero, four slides crossfading on an 8-second beat with the heading over them and progress bars that share the timing. It runs live — CSS only, no script. Swapping in video later replaces the four slide layers with one <video> and keeps the scrim and overlay exactly as they are.
5 · The four routes sit immediately under the hero, in the maroon band: apply, the register, the marketplace, activities.
7 · A notice strip under that, then a full Notices section further down for the formal ones — AGM, renewal, the bylaw amendment.
2 · News is its own section: one lead story with three beside it.
3 + 6 · The calendar and the monthly programme share a section. The calendar is generated from the real March 2027, so 1 March falls on a Monday because it does; dots mark event days by category and 9 March is marked as today.
4 · How to apply is four numbered steps in maroon, then the categories and dues, then registration.

Then the register with partner verification, the committee, and the published documents.

THE CEILING HERE IS PHOTOGRAPHY, and it is the one thing I cannot get.

EF's Instagram is blocked by your network policy. So is every image host. The Drive archive holds personal family snapshots, not EF events.

So the eight images are generated — defocused compositions with figures, stage light and a full tonal range, which is as close to photography as synthetic imagery gets. On a full-bleed hero that gap shows more than anywhere else on the page.

Four hero slides at 1600x900 or wider, one news lead at 3:2 and three news thumbnails at 3:2 would transform this. Drop them in the Engineering Forum folder in Drive — that channel works from here — and I will embed them; the layout needs no other change.

Usage rights must be recorded against every image (BR-059).
